title: The Power of Micro-Influencers: Marketing's New Frontier

facts.fact: The page states that micro-influencers are characterized by follower counts between 10,000 and 100,000.
facts.quote: Micro-influencers, characterized by smaller follower counts between 10,000 and 100,000, challenge the notion that bigger is always better in marketing.

facts.fact: The page cites a Stackla survey, as reported via a Nosto blog, finding that 79% of consumers acknowledge the high impact of user-generated content (UGC) on their purchasing decisions.
facts.quote: reveals that 79% of consumers acknowledge the high impact of UGC on their purchasing decisions

facts.fact: The page cites HubSpot as reporting that small-scale influencers generate up to 60% more engagement than their more prominent counterparts.
facts.quote: reports that small-scale influencers, with their niche appeal, generate up to 60% more engagement than their more prominent counterparts
